name: StreamFlix
overview: Netflix-style UI, server-verified Google Sign-In & Netflix profiles backed by real Jellyfin users
description: Transforms Jellyfin Web into StreamFlix: a Netflix-style cinema UI with an animated show/film mosaic gate, server-verified Google Sign-In (signed sessions), and Netflix 'Who's watching?' profiles mapped to real Jellyfin users with PIN and per-profile Google account locks.

versions.changelog: v0.5.3: add official StreamFlix plugin card logo (thumb.png) for Dashboard & Catalog | v0.5.2: stability & hardening — thread-safe on-disk index.html/branding.xml injection lock, expanded Google OAuth tokeninfo audience verification, clean HTTP 403 handling on direct session authentication errors, trailing-slash tolerance for /Branding/Css, and cached reflected SetPermission discovery | v0.5.1: thread-safe profile sync, constant-time PIN check, ETag CSS caching, and JF12 username sanitization | v0.5: initial public beta release.
